decisions.summary: Markdown-era page paths (research/<page>.md) left in landed specs, including the 101 restored after the sweep glued them onto section ids

The plan already rewrites research/<page>.html and research/<page>/ in landed specs to sections; .md is the same reference to the same page. Pre-existing staleness is not a ground (behavior the GM did not ask to preserve). The 12 non-page names (research/none.md, farms.md, plan, audit/x) are test data or not the record and are out of scope
